summary: First end-to-end test of TrataHealth Master Admin CRM. Backend: 33/33 pytest tests passed covering auth (send/verify OTP, 400 invalid, 403 unknown phone, 401 protected), dashboard stats/feed, contacts CRUD+filters, pipeline (providers only), activities filters, tasks CRUD, notes, team CRUD, analytics, CSV export, global search, and AI insight (Claude via Emergent LLM responded successfully). Frontend: login -> dashboard -> contacts (filter by doctors=35 rows; row click -> detail; AI button responded) -> pipeline (6 columns rendered with item counts and currency totals) -> activities (517 items, tab filters render) -> tasks page loads -> analytics (4 charts present) -> team (members visible) -> global search dropdown returns contacts/activities/tasks for 'Apollo' -> logout redirects to /login.

issues: React hydration warning in console: <span> cannot be a child of <option> in the assigned-to <select> inside data-testid='task-creat...'. Caused by ve-dynamic injected <span> wrappers inside <option> text. Doesn't break functionality but pollutes console and is invalid HTML.

action_items: Optional: in Tasks.jsx, ensure team member <option> children render as plain string (e.g. `{m.name}` directly) so dev-tools instrumentation doesn't wrap them in <span> inside <option>. This removes the hydration warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single ~960-line file; consider splitting into modules (auth, contacts, activities, tasks, ai, seed). Still functional.
All MongoDB queries correctly exclude _id via projection. Good.
AI endpoint has graceful fallback when LLM fails (returns 200 with success=false) - documented and acceptable per request.
All protected endpoints correctly enforce Bearer JWT (verified 401 on missing/invalid token).
